text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — opening a docs PR to consolidate rate/quotas guidance, add a short migration section for the metering label rename, and update the Grafana panel snippet for tiered usage.

Alex: OK. Two quick confirmations: did we permanently rename consumption_total -> usage_tokens_total? I remember an alias for backwards compat.

Maya: Yes, canonical metric is usage_tokens_total. Planning to document a 60-day alias for consumption_total in queries.

Priya: Noted. Also found broken links in pricing -> dashboards, the internal panel IDs changed. I validated a working query for the new metric:
```
sum by (customer_tier) (increase(usage_tokens_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))
```
Recommend docs show label `customer_tier` — ingestion switched `tier` -> `customer_tier` on 2026-02-12.

Tao: Confirming ingestion update. Add a small migration note: dashboards using `tier` will show empty series until they replace it or use our alias layer. Also note burst credits are applied server-side now; they reduce visible quota before billing delta appears.

Maya: Drafted SDK curl snippet for the v2 header guidance, please sanity-check:
```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" \\
  -H \"x-rw-client-metadata: sdk=v2;lang=py;pr=3769012345\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Should we standardize on `x-rw-sdk` instead of `x-rw-client-metadata`?

Alex: Use `x-rw-sdk` — clearer for downstream metrics. Also show new quota headers in the example: `x-rw-quota-remaining` and `x-rw-burst-credit` (response headers). Add a tiny client note to read these for UI quota indicators.

Priya: I'll patch the two broken links and replace absolute dashboard UIDs in the example with relative doc links. Also adding a one-paragraph HOWTO: open panel JSON, replace `\"tier\"` -> `\"customer_tier\"`, save, and re-pin shared view.

Maya: Great. I'll include both queries in the migration note (alias and new label) and keep the consumption_total fallback for 60 days:
```
# Legacy-compatible
sum by (coalesce(customer_tier, tier)) (increase(usage_tokens_total or consumption_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))
```
(Because reviewers will complain, it's intentionally verbose.)

Alex: Nit: don't include raw UIDs in the docs example. Also add a line to the changelog that dashboard owners were notified.

deploy-bot: Maya opened PR #2438: docs: consolidation for rate/quotas + grafana panel fix https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2438

Priya: Quick review done, links fixed and query validated against prod cluster. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks all — merging after CI. I'll post a short note in #announcements tagging dashboard owners and ops. :rocket:
